recent_en: Swift Energy recently secured purchase orders totaling RM59.07 million, including its first substation EPCC project. The company reported a 41.5% increase in FY2026 net profit to RM17.164 million and proposed a final dividend of RM0.006 per share. Additionally, it changed its principal officer and registered address in September.
notable_en: Secured purchase orders totaling RM59.07 million, including its first substation EPCC project.
FY2026 net profit rose 41.5% to RM17.164 million, with a proposed final dividend of RM0.006 per share.
Entered into a memorandum of understanding (MOU).
earnings_en: Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was RM23.715 million, up 6.8% QoQ and 94.4% YoY; net income was RM5.243 million, up 76.7% QoQ and 203.9% YoY; net margin was 22.1%, higher than 13.4% in the previous quarter.
